items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: It might have been Klessy wrote that Pretty Baby.

ctx.x: He used to write the politician songs? No, no, no, no. You wrote a lot of things.
You had Joe Virgis and Klessy and Erwin LeClar. It might have been Klessy wrote that Pretty Baby.
I don't know. We can look it up. He was a pretty good songwriter because he was fortunate.
